title: Office Notes: Fees, Lunch Accounts, and Forms
source_title: Kramer Elementary | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
NOTES 

FROM 

THE 

OFFICE NOTES FROM THE OFFICE

Student Fees:Fees have been loaded to Payschools Central If you wish to pay online. You can also pay in the office with cash or check.Lunch Accounts:As a reminder, you are able to add funds to your student's lunch account through the Payschools Central system. If your student's account reaches -$50 it will be rolled into your school fees. Please be mindful and keep your student's account current. You can use Talawanda EZ Pay, send a check or cash to the school office to take care of your student's balance.Free and Reduced:If you would like to apply for free or reduced lunches, please reach out to the Kramer office or Kramer social worker, Chelsea Pike. We can help walk you through the online application or help you fill out a paper form in the office. If you qualify for FREE lunch, your fees will also be waived. If you qualify for REDUCED, fees will be reduced by 85% and meals will be FREE.Final Forms:Remember, if you have any changes to your information (phone number, address, who can pick up your student, etc) throughout the school year, change it in Final Forms! The office is notified of these changes and will update our information. IF you have an address change, you must submit new proof of residency to the office before we will update your address.

summary: **Student fees** are available to pay online via Payschools Central or in the office with cash/check. **Lunch accounts** can be funded through Payschools Central; accounts reaching -$50 will be added to school fees. Apply for **free or reduced lunch** through the Kramer office or social worker Chelsea Pike—qualifying for free lunch waives all fees, while reduced lunch provides 85% fee reduction and free meals. Update any contact or address changes through **Final Forms** (address changes require new proof of residency submitted to the office).

title: RAH Reading at Home Program Launch
source_title: Kramer Elementary | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content: RAH RAH

Attention Kindergarten, 1st, and 2nd grade families: RAH begins on Wednesday September 30th. This will be our first redemption day, so please return your RAH sheet by Wednesday!Kramer RAH (Reading At Home) is a voluntary program from K-2nd graders that builds a home-school connection by rewarding students for reading at home. Each week students record the books they've read and turn-in record sheets for rewards. Rewards alternate between a student selected book and a small prize.

Family support and involvement are important! Here’s how it works:Read a book, color a book. Books can be read to, by, or with your child. Books can be read multiple times and you can color a book for each time a book is read. Ten pages of a chapter book counts as one book. Fill the page with 20 books read.Send the completed sheet to school with your child on WEDNESDAYS. The first sheet is on the back of this flyer, but any paper with your child’s name and teacher’s name is fine; just draw a star (or other symbol/shape) to represent each book read. Your child will receive a prize for each sheet with 20 books completed!Students will only receive 1 prize a week. However, you may send in up to 2 completed sheets if your child reads beyond 20 books in a week. We will hold on to the extra sheet, using it if your child has missed a Wednesday or forgotten their sheet. Any remaining extra sheets will be tallied at the end of the year. Classrooms that read 1,000 books every 6 weeks will receive a class reward!

summary: The **RAH (Reading At Home) program** for grades K-2 begins **Wednesday, September 30th**, which is the first redemption day. Students record books read at home (books read to, by, or with child; 10 pages of chapter book = 1 book) and submit sheets with 20 books on **Wednesdays** for rewards alternating between books and prizes. Families can submit up to 2 completed sheets per week, and classrooms reading 1,000 books every 6 weeks receive a class reward.
